briefdescription.para: Processes a DAP setBreakpoints request for one source file, and appends the response breakpoints.

detaileddescription.para: Entries for the file whose line is not in the new set are removed through Session::removeBreakpoint. An entry whose line is still requested keeps its DAP id. Each new line goes to addBreakpoint, which resolves it through Session::addBreakpointByLocation. A line that does not resolve keeps an empty engineId, and onReload and onModuleLoad retry it later. This method does not reload symbols. Processor::onSetBreakpoints calls onReload after it writes the response.

parameterdescription.para: Output text that receives the breakpoint objects, as array elements.

detaileddescription.para: Calls Session::loadModuleSymbols for imageName only when an entry has an empty engineId. Then resolves every unresolved entry through onSymbolsLoaded. StopManager calls it when a moduleLoad stop is drained.

briefdescription.para: Manages the full lifecycle of DAP breakpoints against a debug engine session.

detaileddescription.para:
Responsibilities:
Translate DAP setBreakpoints requests into engine breakpoint objects.
Retry unresolved breakpoints when a module loads or symbols reload.
Match incoming engine Breakpoint callbacks to DAP IDs for stopped events.
Remove stale breakpoints when a source file's breakpoint set is replaced.
The manager holds a reference to Session (does not own it). Session must outlive BreakpointManager.
